notes: Stores encrypted change bundles. Production must include attachmentCount before split attachment sync is released.
bundleKind is 'full' or 'delta'. Records without bundleKind are legacy full snapshots. Required for delta sync history walking.
bundleSize stores encrypted bundle payload bytes for metadata-only remote status checks. App uploads tolerate older schemas where this optional field is not deployed yet.
Stores encrypted attachment objects by content hash. Required for iCloud split attachment sync.
